data.name: Pole Fighting
data.description: At 2nd level, as an immediate action, a polearm master can shorten the grip on his spear or polearm with reach and use it against adjacent targets. This action results in a -4 penalty on attack rolls with that weapon until he spends another immediate action to return to the normal grip. The penalty is reduced by -1 for every four levels beyond 2nd. This ability replaces bravery.
